about.text: Akkawi cheese is a white brine cheese from the Levant region, named after the Palestinian city of Acre.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Akkawi is a Levantine white cheese pressed into blocks and kept in a fairly weak brine, and is usually eaten fresh; this gives a semi-hard, chalky-white, firm curd with a salty taste.
